title: Summit Tier Waiver on Crestline Companion Hawaii Surcharge Retention
content:
For holders of Crestline Companion Certificates and Passes, the surcharge retention kept from a Hawaii surcharge refund is reduced by a status waiver that follows the current tier of the holder's Summit membership in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program, as shown on the membership record.

| Current Summit tier | Status waiver of the surcharge retention |
|---|---|
| Summit Diamond | 50 percent |
| Summit Chairman | 50 percent |
| Summit Gold | 25 percent |
| Summit Platinum | 25 percent |
| any other tier (Summit Member, Summit Silver) | none |

The tier read is the one the membership shows at the time of handling.

**Hypothetical case.** A holder at Summit Platinum has 25 percent of the surcharge retention waived; the same holder, had the membership shown Summit Silver, would have none waived.
